model_annotation: Figure 3 illustrates the changes in expenditures for R&D and innovations over a five-year period across various sectors of the national economy. The X-axis is unlabeled but represents a timeline with five distinct points, likely years, spaced at uniform intervals. The Y-axis is labeled with values ranging from 0 to 200,000, marked at intervals of 50,000, and represents expenditures in thousands. Four lines are plotted on the graph, each representing a different sector: "Селско, горско и рибно стопанство" (orange, solid line), "Преработваща промишленост" (blue, solid line), "Търговия и ремонт на автомобили" (gray, solid line), and "Създаване на информационно и творческо съдържание; информационни технологии" (light blue, solid line). The blue line starts around 72,000, remains relatively stable until the fourth point on the X-axis, and then sharply increases to approximately 175,000 by the fifth point. The gray line begins at about 45,000, stays steady until the fourth point, and rises to roughly 125,000 by the fifth. The light blue and orange lines remain relatively flat throughout, staying below 10,000. The graph effectively visualizes the varying trends in R&D and innovation expenditures across different sectors over the observed period.
